title: Case: Print firm asks about a re-attempt fee before its Friday payment run
context: Fernhollow Print disputes a GBP 24.00 failed-delivery re-attempt fee on invoice INV-926 for shipment DL-926. The carrier's Business billing team decides fee waivers.
initial_request: Payment run is Friday. I can see a credit note for 24 quid on the portal so I assume that is the re-attempt fee come off. Can you confirm so I can pay INV-926 less the 24?

events.from: Casimir Ndlovu, Fernhollow Print finance coordinator
events.body: INV-926 has a line 'failed delivery re-attempt, DL-926, GBP 24.00'. We were open and staffed all day on the 3rd. Nobody came. We are not paying for a second attempt at a delivery that was never attempted. Please get it removed.

INV-926, DL-926. Re-attempt fees are waived only where Dispatch has recorded the first failure as carrier-caused. We cannot see Dispatch's attempt records from billing. Send us Dispatch's failure reason code for DL-926 attempt 1 and we will review the line. Until then the invoice stands as issued.

This is an automated acknowledgement from Business billing. Queries are answered within 2 working days. Payment terms remain 14 days from invoice date irrespective of open queries. Plover Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.
Credit note CN-939 raised: GBP 24.00 against INV-939 (DL-939, Fernhollow Print), duplicate collection charge. Visible on the customer's portal statement from today.

saw the billing query on DL-926, this is what we hold. attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 did not leave the depot, vehicle fault, reason code F-07, carrier-caused. attempt 2 on 2026-06-04 delivered 10:14 signed goods-in.

events.from: Casimir Ndlovu, Fernhollow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Separately, the driver on the 4th blocked our loading bay for forty minutes while he ate his lunch. Our production manager wants that noted somewhere.

SERVICE NOTICE 28/26. From 1 July the failed delivery re-attempt fee for business accounts rises from GBP 24.00 to GBP 26.50. Fees for attempts before that date are unchanged. Please do not reply to this address.

events.from: Yusra Pemberton, Fernhollow Print production manager
events.body: Replying to all, not sure this is for me. If it is about the loading bay then yes I want it logged. If it is about invoices that is Casimir not me. Yusra

events.to: Casimir Ndlovu, Fernhollow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Your June statement is ready. Did you know account holders who pay by direct debit never miss a due date? Switch today. Marketing preferences can be changed in your portal profile.

events.to: Casimir Ndlovu, Fernhollow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Statement alert: 1 new credit note on your account. Log in to view.

events.from: Casimir Ndlovu, Fernhollow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Payment run is Friday. I can see a credit note for 24 quid on the portal so I assume that is the re-attempt fee come off. Can you confirm so I can pay INV-926 less the 24?

acceptable_actions.summary: Send Business billing Dispatch's reason code F-07 (vehicle fault, carrier-caused) for DL-926 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 and ask them to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt line on INV-926.

must: Sends Business billing the Dispatch failure reason code F-07, carrier-caused vehicle fault, for DL-926 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03
Asks Business billing to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee on INV-926 and confirm the outcome
Treats the fee as still under review, not waived
must_not: Confirm to Casimir Ndlovu that the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee has been credited (credit note CN-939 is against INV-939 for DL-939)
Tell him to pay INV-926 less GBP 24.00, or state a revised amount due
Promise that the fee will be waived or credited
State as the desk's own finding that the fee was charged in error
expected.reference_message: INV-926, DL-926: the information you asked for on 2026-06-08. Dispatch records attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 as not leaving the depot because of a vehicle fault, reason code F-07, carrier-caused. Attempt 2 on 2026-06-04 was delivered at 10:14. Please review the GBP 24.00 failed delivery re-attempt line on INV-926 on that basis and confirm whether it is waived and, if so, the credit note reference and revised amount due. The customer, Fernhollow Print, has a payment run on Friday and has seen CN-939 on its statement; that credit is against INV-939, so a clear answer on INV-926 before Friday would help.

rationale: Business billing said it will review the fee once it has Dispatch's reason code, and Dispatch has since supplied F-07, carrier-caused. Billing has not been given it. The GBP 24.00 credit note on the portal is for a different invoice, so the desk cannot confirm any deduction from INV-926.

review.note: Coordinator sent reason code F-07 to Business billing by Email and treated the fee as under review, matching the key.
